note: Final release of Al Mouj Muscat's Azura beachfront scheme (570 apartments and 41 chalets), launched Feb 2026 from OMR 69,000 with a 5/5/90 construction-linked plan and floor plans in the developer brochure. Main contractor tenders for the earlier Azura phases were reported only in May 2026, so construction of III and IV has not visibly started; no handover date, project licence or escrow account is published by the developer, although Omani law requires escrow for off-plan sales (checked 1 Nov 2026)

seed.title: freehold
seed.escrow: Sales agent Oman Realty states instalments are paid into the developer's project escrow account; not stated on the developer page
seed.developer_delivered: Al Mouj Muscat handed over more than 2,000 properties at Al Mouj by June 2019 (Oman Observer); Azura I and II sold out but not yet built
seed.payment_plan: 5% on signing, 5% three months after signing, balance aligned with construction milestones

evidence.permit: No off-plan project licence or Ministry approval number published on the developer page, brochure or agent pages; the brochure says the development is subject to final design and authority approvals
evidence.escrow: Oman Realty (sales agent) says all instalments go to the developer's project escrow account; Omani law (Royal Decree 30/2018, now replaced by Royal Decree 79/2025) requires an escrow account for off-plan sales, and the gov.om licence service lists opening an escrow account as a licence step. Developer page itself is silent
evidence.progress: No construction progress published. BNC Network reported in May 2026 that main contractor tenders had only just been issued for Azura Phases 1 and 2
evidence.plans: Developer brochure Azura_Digital_Eng_AZ4.pdf shows unit plans with internal, external and total areas for apartment types and the 305 m2 D-type chalet
evidence.record: Oman Observer (Jun 2019) reported Al Mouj Muscat had handed over more than 2,000 properties; Times of Oman (2016) reported more than 4,000 residents already living in Al Mouj
evidence.returns: No guaranteed rental or ROI language on developer page or launch press
